The '''Ikarranggal''' language, or '''Ogh Ikarranggal''' (Ikaranggal, Ikarranggali), is an [[language death|extinct]] [[Paman language]] of the [[Cape York Peninsula]] in [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. Like several languages in the area, it is often referred to as '''Gogo Mini''' (Kuku-Mini) 'good speech'.
